result.title: VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations
result.summary: Agent skills provide reusable workflows that guide LLM agents in using tools. Refining these workflows requires feedback on missing or incorrect instructions, but task-specific verifiers are not always available. We propose VISE (Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution), a scripts-first approach that uses tool implementations to guide skill revision. It extracts tool capabilities, input requirements, usage conditions, and output formats from source code. Using the task request and execution trace, it compares this information with current workflow instructions to identify missing or conflicting steps. It then recommends specific edits to SKILL.md, linking each change to the relevant implementation and usage conditions. We evaluate VISE as an additional revision stage for four evolution methods on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench. Compared with the corresponding No-verifier conditions, it improves overall average task success by 9.14-13.35 percentage points. The proportion of tasks solved in all three runs increases by 12.36-18.29 points. A case study shows how revised instructions connect tool outputs to later steps. These results support tool implementations as a practical feedback source for skill self-evolution.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VISE：在没有任务专用验证器时，从工具源码中抽取能力、输入要求、使用条件与输出格式，结合任务请求和执行轨迹找出技能文档中缺失或冲突的步骤，并给出带依据的具体修订建议，在 SkillsBench 与 SkillLearnBench 上作为额外修订阶段提升任务成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作用工具实现的语义而非结果验证器来定位轨迹中缺失或冲突的步骤，可供核查其是否能为 LVR 的轨迹监督与贡献分配提供无验证器的反馈信号；但研究对象是文本技能文档，与 latent 状态生成无直接关系。
